title: 第7章 施展秘法救人第8章 城主女儿好感度上升
slug: 和女帝双修后我出剑即无敌
lines: “小子，你知道这是哪里吗？这是城主府，难道不想活了吗？”
一个管家凶神恶煞般的来到了郑元面前威胁道。
一个乳臭未干的小子居然也敢冒充医师，一定是想骗钱来了。
“老爷，要不要把人打出去？”
城主大人可不是什么骗子都能欺骗的。
原来这位中年男人正是浩城的城主，那可是一言九鼎，
周围众人都是一脸鄙视的目光看着郑元。
这家伙一看就是招摇撞骗来骗钱的，赵医师都说楚夫人没救了，他居然说还有救，要是一位老医师说这话大家兴许还能相信几分。
哼！
城主楚梁鼻子里冷哼了一声，自然也不相信郑元的话。
“哎，别动手啊，既然你们不信就算了，小爷我自己走。”
郑元看着气势汹汹围上来的护卫们摇了摇头。
“真是好心当作驴肝肺，算了，这年头好人难当啊！”
郑元抬腿就要走。
此时戴着面纱的女子突然开口说道：“且慢，父亲大人，他是女儿领来的，懂得些医术，要不让他给娘亲看看？”
正是那个戴着面纱的女子，也是城主的女儿，叫楚琳，其实也不知道郑元究竟懂不懂医术，不过娘亲危在旦夕，所以才开口求情。
城主楚梁不禁嘴里犹豫不决中，毕竟赵医师是自己请来的，而且在浩城威望甚高。
这郑元就是一个毛头小子，名不经传，还能有什么精湛的医术。
就在楚梁要回绝时，赵医师突然跳了出来：“小子，你给老夫说说，楚夫人的病症？这是诊方，你要是说不出一二，今天老夫绝饶不了你！”
赵医师那也是有身份的人，刚才被人质疑了，这对一个医师来说绝对是挑衅。
郑元看了看周围的目光，然后接过了诊方。
片刻后开口说道：“久病津亏人消瘦，久病阳虚津不化，久病三焦、经络无功力。”
刚才赵医师还一脸不屑之色，突然脸色一变。
这小子确实有些真才实学，仅仅凭借自己的诊方就一眼看出了楚夫人的病情所在。
至于周围的人都是一头雾水中，毕竟根本不懂医理。
“既然如此，那你能医治楚夫人的重病？”
赵医师又开口问道，不过话语已经温和多了。
虽然丢了面子事大，但这事关一条人命。
作为一个医师来说，治病救人就是最重要的医德。
“我能！”
郑元一口回答道，斩钉截铁，没有丝毫犹豫。
“好，小子，你要是救活本城主夫人，给你万金，如果不能，那就要小心了！”
“如果你现在反悔，本城主就当刚才什么都没发生过。”
城主楚梁声音虽然不大，却带着一股无上威严。
这是一个高手，郑元也不由心里一颤，他修为至少不会低于开脉八层境界。
此时戴着面纱的城主府大小姐一脸希冀的看着郑元。
“你要是治不了还是赶紧离去吧，你放心，我不会让父亲对你不利的。”
楚琳也不知道郑元究竟医术真精湛还是只会些皮毛。
“取蜡烛，热水，毛巾，脸盆……”
郑元看了一眼楚琳，然后吩咐着楚府的下人。
楚琳是造化元阴之体，这可是接近她最好的机会。
content_en:
"Boy, do you know where this is? This is the City Lord's Mansion. Don't you want to live?"
A butler came to Zheng Yuan with a fierce look and threatened him.
A young boy dares to pretend to be a doctor. He must be trying to swindle money.
"Master, do you want to beat him out?"
The Lord of the City is not someone who can be deceived by any liar.
It turned out that this middle-aged man was the city lord of Haocheng, and he kept his promise.
Everyone around looked at Zheng Yuan with contempt.
This guy looked like he was just trying to get money by showing off. Even Dr. Zhao said that Mrs. Chu was hopeless, but he actually said that there was still hope. If an old doctor said this, everyone might still believe it.
snort!
City Lord Chu Liang snorted coldly and naturally did not believe Zheng Yuan's words.
"Hey, don't do it. Since you don't believe it, forget it. I'll go by myself."
Zheng Yuan looked at the guards who gathered around him aggressively and shook his head.
"It's so kind to treat me like a donkey's liver and lungs. Forget it, it's hard to be a good person these days!"
Zheng Yuan raised his legs to leave.
At this time, the woman wearing a veil suddenly said: "Wait a minute, father, he was brought by my daughter and he knows some medical skills. Why don't you show him to my mother?"
It was the veiled woman who was also the city lord's daughter, named Chu Lin. She actually didn't know whether Zheng Yuan knew medical skills, but her mother was in danger, so she asked for mercy.
"This?"
City Lord Chu Liang couldn't help but hesitate in his mouth. After all, Dr. Zhao was invited by himself and he had a high prestige in Haocheng.
This Zheng Yuan is just a young boy with little reputation, but he has no superb medical skills.
Just when Chu Liang was about to refuse, Dr. Zhao suddenly jumped out: "Boy, tell me about Mrs. Chu's illness? This is the diagnosis. If you can't tell me something, I will never spare you today!"
Dr. Zhao is also a person with status. He was questioned just now. This is definitely a provocation for a doctor.
Zheng Yuan looked at the people around him and then took the diagnosis.
After a moment, he said: "A chronic illness with fluid deficiency makes a person lose weight, a chronic illness with yang deficiency and fluid deficiency, and a chronic illness with triple energizer and meridians without power."
Doctor Zhao had a look of disdain on his face just now, but his expression suddenly changed.
This boy does have some real talent and knowledge, and he could tell the extent of Mrs. Chu's condition at a glance just by relying on his own diagnosis.
As for the people around him, they were all confused. After all, they didn't understand medical science at all.
"In that case, can you cure Mrs. Chu's serious illness?"
Dr. Zhao asked again, but his words were much gentler.
Although losing face is a big deal, it is a matter of life.
As a doctor, treating illnesses and saving lives is the most important medical ethics.
"I can!"
Zheng Yuan answered decisively without any hesitation.
"Okay, boy, if you save the city lord's wife, I will give you ten thousand gold. If not, then be careful!"
"If you regret it now, this city lord will pretend that nothing happened just now."
Although the voice of the city lord Chu Liang was not loud, it carried a sense of supreme majesty.
This is a master, and Zheng Yuan can't help but tremble in his heart. His cultivation level is at least not lower than the eighth level of opening pulses.
At this time, the eldest lady of the City Lord's Mansion, who was wearing a veil, looked at Zheng Yuan expectantly.
"If you can't cure it, you should leave quickly. Don't worry, I won't let my father do anything bad to you."
Chu Lin didn't know whether Zheng Yuan's medical skills were really superb or just superficial.
"Get candles, hot water, towels, washbasin..."
Zheng Yuan glanced at Chu Lin, and then ordered the servants of the Chu Mansion.
Chu Lin is the body of creation Yuan Yin, this is the best opportunity to get close to her.
title_en: Chapter 7: Using a secret method to save people Chapter 8: The favorability of the city lord’s daughter increases
